title: Director of Manufacturing
text:
**Company Description**
The Father’s Table is a privately owned national dessert manufacturer based in sunny Sanford, Florida, known for its innovation and extensive product lines. The company serves multiple channels, including national retail accounts, food service, wholesale clubs, convenience stores, and school lunch programs, reaching far beyond local bakeries. Its offerings range from grab-and-go convenience items to decadent, restaurant-quality desserts such as creamy cheesecakes and home-style cake rolls. A unique production process and strong company values have helped The Father’s Table become the #1 branded cheesecake in the retail in-store bakery segment. Applicants can learn more about the company by visiting www.thefatherstable.com.

**Director of Manufacturing**

Department: Operations Reports To: President ,Direct Reports: Plant Managers, Senior Manager of Cheesecake Production, Position Summary: The Director of Manufacturing provides strategic and operational leadership across two manufacturing facilities overseeing approximately 1,000 employees. This role serves as the primary architect of operational excellence moving the organization toward more data-driven decisions. The Director standardizes processes, drives toward modern manufacturing systems (KPIs, OEE, ERP), ensures food safety, and champions the successful implementation and optimization of our core cheesecake production lines.

---

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

**1. Change Management & Professionalization**

· Standardize Operations: Develop, implement, and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) across both plants to ensure consistency in quality, safety, and efficiency.

· Cultivate Leadership: Mentor, coach, and upskill plant managers and front-line supervisors, shifting the culture from firefighting to proactive, structured problem-solving.

· Data-Driven Culture: Introduce and track rigorous key performance indicators (KPIs) and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) metrics to guide daily, weekly, and monthly business reviews.

**2. Core Product Implementation & Optimization (Cheesecake Operations)**

· Product Optimization: Partner with the Senior Production Manager to evaluate all new cheesecake formulas, sizes, and configurations introduced into production.

· Constraint Assessment: Review new product introductions to assess potential issues or constraints affecting quality performance, labor efficiency, run rates, and operating costs.

· Executional Direction: Provide hands-on, "feet-on-the-floor" leadership to the operations team during major line optimizations, ERP system changes, and plant renovations.

**3. Food Safety, Quality & Compliance**

· Regulatory & Legality: Ensure both facilities strictly adhere to FDA, USDA, OSHA, and local regulations, taking ultimate responsibility for the safety and legality of all food products.

· Audit Readiness: Maintain "always audit-ready" standards for SQF, BRC, or other GFSI-benchmarked certifications and retail customer audits.

· Safety Culture: Champion a zero-injury safety culture through robust Hazard Identification, training, and behavioral safety programs.

4. Financial & Strategic Management

· P&L Responsibility: Manage the manufacturing budget, labor costs, variances, and operational expenses across both plants.

· CAPEX Planning: Identify, justify, and execute capital expenditure (CAPEX) projects aimed at automation, capacity expansion, and facility modernization.

---

**Required Qualifications**

· Experience: 10+ years of progressive food production operations management experience, with at least 5+ years in a multi-plant or regional leadership role.

· Scale & Product Expertise: Proven track record of managing a large workforce (500–1,000+ employees) in high-volume environments, with deep knowledge of automated bakery or cheesecake production processes.

· Transformation Experience: Demonstrated success leading an organization through a professionalization journey or significant operational scaling.

· Education: Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related technical field. An MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

· Certifications: Lean/Six Sigma Green or Black Belt highly desirable. Full understanding of SQF/BRC and HACCP systems.

---

**Physical Demands & Work Environment**

· Mobility: Must be able to travel between both manufacturing facilities on a daily/regular basis and spend significant time on the shop floor.

· Environment: Willingness to work in production environments with moderate-to-high noise levels (requiring hearing protection) and varying temperatures ranging from 45°F to 95°F.

* · Physical Capability: Ability to stand and walk for extended periods (up to 8–12 hours) during plant walkthroughs and occasionally lift or handle up to 35–50 lbs when assisting on the line
